Title: Create a new order with measurement item parameter identification (nsId) included
Preconditions: A registered shop exists and a customer is available in the system
Steps:
1. Submit a request to create a new order containing an item with measurement details, providing an nsId value 'NS-101' alongside measurement values. 2. Fetch the created order details using the generated order ID.

Test Data: Customer Phone: '01700000000', Item ID: 1, Measurement Parameter: 'Chest', Value: '40.0', Unit: 'inch', nsId: 'NS-101', Making Charge: 500
Expected Result: The order is created successfully with HTTP 200 OK and the retrieved order details include 'NS-101' for the measurement parameter.

Title: Update an existing order with measurement parameter identification (nsId)
Preconditions: An existing order with item measurements exists in the system
Steps:
1. Submit an update request for the existing order, specifying measurement parameters with updated nsId values. 2. Retrieve the order details by order ID.

Test Data: Order ID: 1, Customer Phone: '01700000000', Item ID: 1, Measurement Parameter: 'Waist', Value: '34.0', Unit: 'inch', nsId: 'NS-202', Making Charge: 600
Expected Result: The order updates successfully with HTTP 200 OK and the order response retains and displays 'NS-202' for the updated measurement parameter.

Title: Attempt to create an order item measurement with a non-numeric value for NUMERIC parameter type
Preconditions: A valid shop and customer exist in the system.
Steps:
1. Submit a POST request to create an order (/api/orders) containing an order item measurement group. 2. In the measurement payload, set parameter type to 'NUMERIC' and value to a non-numeric string ('abc').

Test Data: type: 'NUMERIC', value: 'abc', nsId: 'NS-101'
Expected Result: The system rejects the order creation request with an HTTP 400 Bad Request error indicating that 'abc' is not a valid numeric measurement value.

Title: Create an order with measurement parameter containing a null nsId boundary value
Preconditions: A shop exists in the system and is ready to process new orders
Steps:
1. Submit a request to create a new order with valid shop and customer details. 2. Include an order item with a measurement group containing one measurement where the nsId field is explicitly set to null. 3. Verify the creation response body and measurement details.

Test Data: Shop ID: 1, Customer Name: 'Jane Doe', Phone: '01700000000', Measurement Name: 'Chest', Value: '38.0', Type: 'NUMERIC', nsId: null
Expected Result: The order is created successfully with HTTP 200 OK status, and the returned measurement payload contains nsId as null without error.

Title: Create an order with measurement parameter containing an empty string nsId boundary value
Preconditions: A shop exists in the system and is ready to process new orders
Steps:
1. Submit a request to create a new order with valid shop and customer details. 2. Include an order item with a measurement group containing one measurement where the nsId field is an empty string (""). 3. Verify the creation response body and measurement details.

Test Data: Shop ID: 1, Customer Name: 'Jane Doe', Phone: '01700000000', Measurement Name: 'Waist', Value: '32.0', Type: 'NUMERIC', nsId: ""
Expected Result: The order is created successfully with HTTP 200 OK status, and the returned measurement payload preserves the empty string ("") as the nsId.
